info.title: MACsec_SecY
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

bypass.description: Features to bypass MACsec processing on this SecY.

ieee_bpdu_enabled.description: Bypass MACsec protection for IEEE BPDU frames. When enabled, packets with destination MAC as one of the IEEE BPDU MACs (01:80:c2:00:00:0*) will bypass the MACsec engine in both the Tx and Rx directions.

cipher_suite.description: The MACsec cipher-suite used to protect MACsec frames on this SecY.  `gcm-aes-128`:     Use Galois/Counter mode of operation with the                     AES-128 symmetric block cipher.  `gcm-aes-256`:     Use Galois/Counter mode of operation with the                     AES-256 symmetric block cipher.  `gcm-aes-xpn-128`: Use Galois/Counter mode of operation with the                     AES-128 symmetric block cipher with extended                     packet numbering.  `gcm-aes-xpn-256`: Use Galois/Counter mode of operation with the                     AES-256 symmetric block cipher with extended                     packet numbering.

clear_tag_mode.description: Ethernet data in a MACsec PDU that must precede the MACsec SecTAG in clear text on this SecY. `none`:  The SecTAG directly follows the destination and source          MAC address in a MACsec PDU. `dot1q`: Send the 802.1q tag in clear in a MACsec PDU.          When configured, untagged traffic is not allowed on the          MACsec channel.

bytes_tx.description: Number of bytes (without preamble and CRC) received.

confidentiality_offset.description: Confidentiality-offset to use on this SecY.  `byte_0`:  the entire Ethernet frame is sent encrypted.  `byte_30`: the data following the first 30 bytes of the Ethernet             frame is sent encrypted.  `byte_50`: the data following the first 50 bytes of the Ethernet             frame is sent encrypted.

controlled_port_enable.description: Enable the controlled port of this SecY.

controlled_port_state.description: State of the controlled port (CP) associated with this SecY. `init`:          The CP is initialized. `secured`:       The CP is waiting for a new SAK to be generated. `receive`:       A new SAK is generated and the receive SAs are                  for the new SAK are created on the CP. `receiving`:     The receive SAs are in use on the CP. `ready`:         The CP is ready to transmit. `transmit`:      The transmit SA is created on the CP. `transmitting`:  The transmit SA is in use on the CP. `abandon`:       The current SAs are being abandoned on the CP as                  a result of a new SAK being generated. `retire`:        The current SAs are being abandoned on the CP as                  the SAK is use has expired.

egress_drop_packets_rx.description: Number of received packets that are dropped on egress port.

egress_error_packets_rx.description: Number of erroneous packets received on egress port.

ingress_drop_packets_rx.description: Number of received packets that are dropped on ingress port.

ingress_error_packets_rx.description: Number of erroneous packets received on ingress port.

eapol_eth_type.description: The Ether-Type used in EAPoL frames for MKA on this SecY. When empty, the default Ether-Type 0x888e is used.

id.description:
Reference Resource: [MACsec_SecY](#/MACsec_SecY)
The identifier associated with the SecY.

include_sci_disable.description: Disable inclusion of Secure Channel Identifier (SCI) in MACsec frames on this SecY.

interface.description:
Reference Resource: [MACsec_SecY](#/MACsec_SecY)
The interface on which the SecY is instantiated.

kay_mka.description:
Reference Resource: [MACsec_KaY_MKA](#/MACsec_KaY_MKA)
MACSec Key Agreement Entity associated with this SecY.

macsec_policy.description:
Reference Resource: [MACsec_Policy](#/MACsec_Policy)
MACsec policy associated with the SecY.

mka_policy.description:
Reference Resource: [MKA_Policy](#/MKA_Policy)
MKA policy associated with the SecY.

peer_mac.description: MAC address of the peer that is bound to the SecY.

replay_protect_disable.description: Disable replay protection on this SecY.

replay_window.description: Replay protection window associated with this SecY. When a packet is received, it is processed only if the Packet Number (PN) associated with this packet is within the replay window. This is only applicable if the replay protection is enabled for this SecY.

badtag_packets_rx.description: Number of packets discarded with an invalid SecTAG or a zero value PN or an invalid ICV.

control_packets_rx.description: Number of packets identified as control packets received.

control_packets_tx.description: Number of packets identified as control packets transmitted.

no_sci_packets_rx.description: Number of received packets discarded with unknown SCI information.

notag_packets_rx.description: Number of packets discarded with no SecTAG (MAC security tag).

over_run_packets_rx.description: Number of packets discarded because the number of received packets exceeded the cryptographic performance capabilities.

tagged_control_packets_rx.description: Number of tagged packets identified as control packets received.

transform_error_packets_rx.description: Number of received packets discarded when extracting the MACsec payload from the MACsec frame.

transform_error_packets_tx.description: Number of transmitted packets discarded when adding a MACsec header to the MACsec payload.

unknown_sci_packets_rx.description: Number of packets received with an unknown SCI.

untagged_packets_rx.description: Number of packets received without a SecTAG.

untagged_packets_tx.description: Number of packets transmitted without a SecTAG (MAC security tag).

type.description: The type of the SecY.  `real`:    A SecY that is provisioned upfront and maps directly             to the interface on which it is instantiated.  `virtual`: A SecY that is created on demand to provide             separate secure connectivity associations over the             same LAN.

egress_drop_packets_rx.description: Number of received packets that are dropped on egress port.

egress_error_packets_rx.description: Number of erroneous packets received on egress port.

ingress_drop_packets_rx.description: Number of received packets that are dropped on ingress port.

ingress_error_packets_rx.description: Number of erroneous packets received on ingress port.

parameters.name: Interface.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Interface](#/Interface)
The interface name. For non-bonded ports, the interface name is the same as the associated port name. The name must otherwise be unique across all ports and interfaces of the system.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
